title: Calibration harness: lightweight customer-specific checks for catalog/model pin changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Catalog or tenant-pinned model version changes (including quantization/config diffs) can introduce subtle regressions in quality that only show up for a subset of customers. Running full eval battery for every pin is expensive and slow.

Goal: Ship a low-cost, fast "calibration harness" that runs a targeted, tenant-aware smoke check when a catalog or customer-pinned model version changes. The harness should: run within strict cost/time budgets, surface signal for rollback/hold decisions, and integrate into the pin promotion workflow. It must support both catalog-initiated promotions and tenant-specific pins.

Scope: Define sampling policies (per-tenant or clustered-tenants), curated compact test suites (10–50 prompts per workload category), pass/fail thresholds, cost/time budget enforcement, and integration points with rollout/orchestration (canary, hold-on-fail). This ticket covers PM scoping, acceptance criteria, and orchestration contract; engineering work will be tracked in ENG follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness runs automatically when a catalog or tenant model pin event occurs (both UI and API flows)
By default, harness executes a compact test suite (< 60s wall time, < $0.50 expected cost per run) and reports a deterministic pass/fail signal
Tenant sampling respects per-tenant traffic tiers and opt-out flags; high-traffic tenants are sampled more aggressively
Signal is emitted to rollout controller with failure reasons (fidelity delta, token-level latency regressions, safety-score drops)
Run results are visible in Console (per-run summary, example failures, and historic runs) and emitted as an event to eval-webhooks for downstream automation
Operational playbook documented for false positives, ignored diffs, and manual override of holds
tasks: Finalize compact test-suite definitions for core workloads (chat, completion, reranking, embeddings)
Define tenant-sampling policy and default budget tiers (small/medium/large)
Design event schema for harness results (summary + top-5 failing examples + metrics)
Specify orchestration contract with rollout controller (hold thresholds, timeouts, retry policy)
Coordinate with Console team for run visibility UX and retention settings
Create implementation tickets for ENG: harness runner, sampling service, webhook sink, and rollout integration
risks_and_tradeoffs: Sampling smaller tenant subsets reduces cost but increases false-negative risk for tenant-specific regressions
Tighter budgets (<= $0.50) force smaller test suites which may miss nuanced fidelity regressions
Pushing more logic into rollout controller increases coupling; alternative is a lightweight decision service that returns a hold/ok signal
Performance-sensitive checks (latency SLOs) may need warmed caches or dedicated warmup tokens to be meaningful
operational_playbook: If harness fails for >5% of sampled tenants on a catalog promotion, automatically pause rollout and notify oncall + PM
For transient failures (timeout or infra errors), auto-retry with exponential backoff up to 2 attempts before declaring unknown
Provide a manual 'force promote' with signed audit entry; require engineering + PM approval for overrides
Log all harness output to centralized eval-results store and attach to pin-change event for auditing
metrics_to_track: False-positive rate (investigations that later mark harness as non-actionable)
Number of rollouts paused by harness signals
